svg.aria-label: A pipeline: your repository is indexed into a graph, a question finds seeds, the graph is walked, candidates are ranked and packed to a budget, and the capsule is measured before it is returned
svg.title: How a question becomes an answer

svg.text: The answer is measured, not estimated.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The capsule prints its own cost, so that cost is part of what it costs. It is rendered, measured, and trimmed until it fits.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It never exceeds the budget you set.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When the budget is tight it drops detail in steps — source, then signatures, then names — instead of breaking.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No network symbol is linked into the binary. It cannot open a socket.
